newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin names Coffman CEO.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin names Coffman CEO.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said on Friday its directors elected Vance D. Coffman as president and chief executive officer effective August one.

Coffman will succeed Norman R. Augustine, who said he will retire from his post as chief executive officer to pursue outside interests. Augustine will continue to serve as chairman of the board of directors, Lockheed said.
Augustine served as the company's chief executive since January 1996, the company said.
Coffman, 53, currently president and chief operating officer, previously served as president of Lockheed's space and strategic missiles sector.
The company also said Peter Teets, presently chief operating officer of its information and services sector, will become executive vice president and chief operating officer of the corporation.
It said Augustine, 61, plans to focus on education and public service after retirement, and will join the faculty at Princeton University in the fall.
